title: scripts/seed_default_user.py — default admin seeder
scope: Idempotent one-shot script to insert the default SUPERVISOR (admin/admin123). Checks if username='admin' exists via direct DB query; if found, prints 'admin already exists — skipping' and exits. If not found: hashes 'admin123' via get_password_hash, inserts tbl_user_master row (username='admin', role='SUPERVISOR', is_active=True), commits, prints 'seeded admin user'. Prints warning to stderr: 'WARNING: Change admin password on first login.' Run once after alembic upgrade head.

success_criteria.manual: cd backend && python scripts/seed_default_user.py → 'seeded admin user'. Second run → 'admin already exists — skipping'.
success_criteria.automated: Implicitly verified by TC-208 (POST /auth/login with admin/admin123 returns 200) once PO runs the seed script before /ases-integration-test.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Script exits cleanly on both first-run and repeat-run. No exception raised on duplicate (idempotent). WARNING message printed to stderr.

checkout_prompt: scripts/seed_default_user.py created. Idempotent admin seeder. Prints WARNING to stderr on success. Ready for PO bring-up step.
